SELECT T2.School, T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM schools AS T2
INNER JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T2.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website 
FROM schools 
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') 
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') 
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') 
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website 
FROM schools 
WHERE Virtual = 'P' 
  AND Charter = 1 
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County 
FROM schools 
WHERE SOC = 11 
  AND StatusType = 'Closed' 
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' 
GROUP BY County 
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND T1.`High Grade` = '9'

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, T2.GSserved, T2.School 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.State = 'CA' 
ORDER BY T2.Latitude ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(schools.School), schools.City, COUNT(DISTINCT schools.City)
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
  AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY schools.City

SELECT T2.`District Code`,
       T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT admemail1, admemail2, admemail3
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND city = 'San Bernardino'
  AND statusType = 'Active'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND opendate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010';
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users);

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.ParentId = 107829 AND T2.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT DISTINCT UserId
FROM postHistory
WHERE UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Views >= 1000)
GROUP BY UserId, PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS Badge
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) = (
        SELECT MAX(CommentCount)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
            FROM comments
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS counts
    )
);

SELECT 
    ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) 
     FROM comments c 
     WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommenters
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
INNER JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(users.UpVotes) / COUNT(users.Id) AS AvgUpVotes,
       SUM(users.Age) / COUNT(users.Id) AS AvgAge
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
GROUP BY users.Id
HAVING COUNT(users.Id) > 10;

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Name = 'Teacher' THEN UserId END) * 100.0 / COUNT(UserId) AS Percentage
FROM badges;

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0'

SELECT DISTINCT users.Age
FROM users
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010';
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN Id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN Id END) FROM votes

SELECT DISTINCT posts.Tags
FROM posts
INNER JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT MAX(T.TotalViews)
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(T1.ViewCount) AS TotalViews
    FROM posts AS T1
    JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
    WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR T2.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM badges 
WHERE Name = 'Commentator' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT users.DisplayName, users.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT 
    p.Id AS PostId,
    p.Title,
    COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount,
    p.LastEditDate
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN postHistory ph 
    ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title, p.LastEditDate;

SELECT users.LastAccessDate, users.Location
FROM users
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE badges.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT p.Id AS PostId, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2013';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000;
SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users);

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens' 
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CommentCount
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (
    SELECT Id
    FROM posts
    WHERE Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts)
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_posts
FROM posts
WHERE ViewCount > 35000
  AND CommentCount = 0;

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
  AND b.Date = (
      SELECT MAX(b2.Date)
      FROM badges b2
      JOIN users u2 ON b2.UserId = u2.Id
      WHERE u2.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumAdultUsers
FROM users
WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
  AND UpVotes > 5000;

SELECT Date - CreationDate
FROM badges AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Zolomon';

SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN tags ON posts.Tags LIKE '%' || tags.TagName || '%' 
WHERE tags.TagName = 'careers';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM comments c
   WHERE c.PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Clustering 1D data')) AS NumComments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM posts p
   WHERE p.ParentId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Clustering 1D data')
     AND p.PostTypeId = 2) AS NumAnswers;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN stats_posts.Score > 50 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(stats_posts.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts AS stats_posts
JOIN users ON stats_posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%linear regression%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT users.Id)
FROM users
JOIN comments ON users.Id = comments.UserId
WHERE comments.Score = 0
  AND users.Age = 40;

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN users.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(comments.UserId) AS Percentage
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT T1.CustomerID 
FROM customers AS T1 
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 
ORDER BY T2.Consumption ASC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
  AND T2.Consumption < 30000

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'SME'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS DIFF_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS DIFF_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'SME'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS DIFF_KAM_SME;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth T 
JOIN customers C ON T.CustomerID = C.CustomerID 
WHERE T.Date = 201305 AND C.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.Consumption > 46.73 THEN ym.CustomerID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) AS Percentage
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date LIKE '2012%';

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) AS BiggestMonthlyConsumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
);

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Description
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID
WHERE T2.Date = '201309'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country
FROM gasstations AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(T3.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND SUBSTR(T3.Date, 5, 2) = '06';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Consumption > 1000

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date, t.Time
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT T1.Currency
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Date LIKE '201306%' AND T2.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT T2.Country 
FROM transactions_1k AS T1 
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID, c.Currency
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
) sub;

SELECT 
    SUM(t1.Price) AS total_amount_spent,
    (SELECT SUM(t2.Price) 
     FROM transactions_1k t2 
     WHERE t2.CustomerID = 38508 
       AND t2.Date = '201201') AS amount_spent_january_2012
FROM transactions_1k t1
WHERE t1.CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT c.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT PA.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
GROUP BY PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  )
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '2012'
  AND T2.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(T3.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T4.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS T3
      JOIN Team AS T4 ON T3.team_api_id = T4.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', T3.date) = '2012'
        AND T3.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND T2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND T2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND T2.chanceCreationPassing < (

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
GROUP BY member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(expense.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT m.major_name, mj.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major mj ON mem.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN major m ON mj.major_id = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, maj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.alignment = 'Bad') * 100 / COUNT(T2.id) AS percentage,
       SUM(T1.alignment = 'Bad' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS marvel_count
FROM alignment AS T1
JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T2.alignment_id = T1.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.publisher_id
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;
SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT T1.superhero_name, T2.race
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.id)
FROM publisher AS T1
JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.publisher_id
JOIN gender AS T3 ON T2.gender_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler');

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower s ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' 
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg < 100
  AND colour.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS in_patient_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';
SELECT T1.`aCL IgM` FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'

SELECT Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GPT = '9' AND Laboratory.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2
  AND Examination.ANA = 'S'
  AND Examination.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                            + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' 
  AND T3.CRP > 2 
  AND T3.CRE = 1 
  AND T3.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET DISEASE'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.ID, L.Date, L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT Patient.*
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Outside normal range'
       END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
) T
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT L.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30 
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.IGG > 900 AND T3.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS Percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(Patient.Birthday) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON a1.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top_elements
ORDER BY element ASC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond)
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS REAL) / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS c 
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' 
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') 
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, ct.total_consumption
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_seg ms
      ON ct.Segment = ms.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010');

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(TA2.id)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS pid FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) m
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = m.pid
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_w)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_w
        FROM (
            SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS pid FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
            SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
        ) m2
        JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = m2.pid
        JOIN Country c2 ON c2.id = m2.country_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    )
);

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id

  AND T3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)

SELECT c.type

SELECT district.A3 AS region

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1997' THEN loan.amount END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount END))
    * 100.0 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT
    d.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'contract finished, loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'contract running, OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'contract running, client in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    MAX(0, l.amount - l.payments * MIN(
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12 +
        (CAST(strftime('%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)),
        l.duration
    )) AS remaining_debt
FROM disp d
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM attendance 
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id

JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
GROUP BY event.event_id, event.event_name

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'

SELECT COUNT(event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(e.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    -- divided by how many such customers there are (handles ties)
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM per_customer AS p
    JOIN segment_min AS s
      ON s.Segment = p.Segment
     AND s.MinConsumption = p.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element

    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minima m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment, SUM(cz.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN mins m ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

       CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND substr(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id

SELECT a.date

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

         WHEN CAST(substr(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) < 50

         ELSE 1900 + CAST(substr(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       * 100
       / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS paid_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS remaining_debt,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Loan finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Loan finished - debt unpaid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Loan running - payments OK'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Loan running - indebted (late on payments)'
    END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l
    ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t
    ON t.account_id = l.account_id
   AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
   AND t.date >= l.date
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY c.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status;

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
         THEN 'In-patient' ELSE 'Outpatient'
       END AS More_Common,
       (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)) * 100.0
         / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS Deviation_Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID,
       strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T2.Date, strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC, T2.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1."aCL IgM"
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12';

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = '1992-06-12'
  AND L.GPT = '9';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'

SELECT julianday(MIN(E.`Examination Date`)) - julianday(P.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID, 
       l.ALP, 
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS `ALP within normal range`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday LIKE '1982-04-01%';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday, Patient.Description, Patient."First Date", Patient.Admission, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN CAST(l.ALB AS REAL) BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS "Within Normal Range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
)
AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

WHERE l.IGG > 900
  AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(L.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1

WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT P.Diagnosis

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS average
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) 
FROM connected c 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM connected c

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count

WITH czk_lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth)
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
minseg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_c
  FROM base
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avgseg AS (
  SELECT b.Segment, SUM(b.Consumption) / COUNT(b.CustomerID) AS avg_c
  FROM base b
  JOIN minseg m ON b.Segment = m.Segment AND b.Consumption = m.min_c
  GROUP BY b.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH italy_matches AS (
    SELECT m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
           m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
           m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
           m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
           m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
match_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestPerSegment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinPerSegment m
      ON m.Segment = ct.Segment AND m.MinConsumption = ct.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg ELSE 0 END) AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM LowestPerSegment;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_c
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_c) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_c
  FROM totals t
  JOIN (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_c) AS min_c
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
  ) m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total_c = m.min_c
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM lowest;
