WITH cust_total AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_total ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_customers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) AS sum_consumption, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM least_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

FROM Player p

WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
    M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
) pc
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pc.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

WITH im AS (
    SELECT m.home_player_1 AS hp1, m.home_player_2 AS hp2, m.home_player_3 AS hp3, m.home_player_4 AS hp4, m.home_player_5 AS hp5, m.home_player_6 AS hp6, m.home_player_7 AS hp7, m.home_player_8 AS hp8, m.home_player_9 AS hp9, m.home_player_10 AS hp10, m.home_player_11 AS hp11,
           m.away_player_1 AS ap1, m.away_player_2 AS ap2, m.away_player_3 AS ap3, m.away_player_4 AS ap4, m.away_player_5 AS ap5, m.away_player_6 AS ap6, m.away_player_7 AS ap7, m.away_player_8 AS ap8, m.away_player_9 AS ap9, m.away_player_10 AS ap10, m.away_player_11 AS ap11
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
players AS (
    SELECT hp1 AS pid FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT hp11 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap1 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT ap11 FROM im
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN players pl ON p.player_api_id = pl.pid
WHERE pl.pid IS NOT NULL;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes;

FROM district d

FROM client

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1997%' OR l.date LIKE '97%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1996%' OR l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '1996%' OR l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'in-patient' 
        ELSE 'outpatient' 
    END AS more_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAvg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAvg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS SME_LAM_Diff,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS LAM_KAM_Diff,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'

FROM (
  SELECT
    l.amount,
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(l.date) = 6 THEN '19' || SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4)
      END AS INTEGER

  FROM loan l
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d

) t

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM;

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan not paid (debt)'
        WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Contract running, payments OK'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Contract running, in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    MAX(
        l.amount - (l.payments * MIN(
            (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12
            + (CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)),
            l.duration
        )),
        0
    ) AS remaining_debt
FROM loan l

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT T1.Date FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.ALB = (SELECT MAX(T2.ALB) FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination));

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T3.atom_id) AS average
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
INNER JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T1.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule_id
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected c1
JOIN atom a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c1.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected c
        JOIN atom b1 ON c.atom_id = b1.atom_id
        JOIN atom b2 ON c.atom_id2 = b2.atom_id
        GROUP BY b1.element, b2.element
    ) t
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS proportion
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') 
   OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(T1.element) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T4.bond_type) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id 
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346' 
GROUP BY T1.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_seg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM base
  GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT b.Segment, b.Consumption
  FROM base b
  JOIN min_seg m ON b.Segment = m.Segment AND b.Consumption = m.min_consumption
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
  FROM lowest
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match

) m ON m.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id

WITH pc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
)
SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN pc ON pc.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(pc.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(pc2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN pc pc2 ON pc2.country_id = c2.id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
)
AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');
SELECT (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'North Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'East Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinTotals m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'

       CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) 
FROM (
    SELECT l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
      AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5))

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`

FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT b.molecule_id

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT T1.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           z.CustomerID,
           z.total_consumption
    FROM czk2013 AS z
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

           WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan not paid - debt of ' || l.amount
           WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Loan running, payments made so far without debt'

WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID, c.Segment
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND t.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, z.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN czk_customers z ON y.CustomerID = z.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, z.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT s.Segment, SUM(s.total_consumption) AS sum_total, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM segment_consumption s
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY s.Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_total * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    SELECT MAX(CommentCount) AS MaxCount

)

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, only CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinTotals AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAvg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consuming
    -- customer(s) / number of such customers, per segment
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinTotals m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment
     AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT
    d.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - t.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id   = d.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female: smallest birth_date (older person => smaller birth_date)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
  )
  -- among the oldest females, keep only the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND t.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(t2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district t2 ON c2.district_id = t2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (
                SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                FROM client
                WHERE gender = 'F'
          )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name

WHERE m.position = 'Member'

SELECT event_name

WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed' 
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT

    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member AS m

    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN attendance AS a 
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND mj.major_name = 'education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m 
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b 
    ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev 
    ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 
    ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT 
    major.major_name,
    major.department
FROM member
JOIN major 
    ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' 
  AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj 
    ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name

HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s

WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id

  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female_heroes
FROM superhero
JOIN gender    ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT full_name
FROM superhero
WHERE weight_kg = 0
   OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT
    al.alignment,
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment al ON s.alignment_id = al.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2
  ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS num_in_patients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS num_out_patients,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, 
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX(Birthday)) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS age_at_first_visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    -- Numerator: number of (patient, lab) records for males with UA <= 8.0
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    /
    -- Denominator: number of (patient, lab) records for females with UA <= 6.5
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', Laboratory.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2   -- i.e., AVG * 1.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', BIRTHDAY) = '1980' 
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND P.Admission = '-'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT CAST(
    julianday(replace(Examination.`Examination Date`, '/', '-')) -
    julianday(replace(Patient.`First Date`, '/', '-'))
    AS INTEGER
) AS days_before_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - above normal range'
    END AS ALP_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS alb_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(t.UA) AS avg_UA
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID,
           L.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS L
) AS t
INNER JOIN Patient AS P
    ON P.ID = t.ID
WHERE t.rn = 1
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    Patient.SEX, 
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_list
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory 
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND l.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 
  AND l.IGG < 2000 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`) AS FirstRecordedDate
FROM Patient AS T2
WHERE T2.ID = (
    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T1
    WHERE T1.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T1.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(c.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id
                        FROM connected c
                        UNION
                        SELECT c.atom_id2
                        FROM connected c);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c';

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(b.bond_id),
           5
       ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS result
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       m.molecule_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'Non-Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN label = '-' THEN 'Non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_atoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (CZK payers only)
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- The least amount of consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consumption customers:
    -- (their total consumption) / (number of such customers)
    SELECT
        l.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM consumption_2013 t
    JOIN lowest_per_segment l
      ON t.Segment = l.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY l.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME_minus_LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM_minus_KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM_minus_SME";

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y 
    ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND yearmonth.Date = 201305;

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth y
     JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' 
       AND y.Consumption > 46.73) * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
     FROM customers c
     WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM') AS percentage;

FROM customers

SELECT MAX(T.monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS T;

        FROM Player_Attributes

        SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match

    SELECT *
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),

    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)
SELECT AVG(height) AS average_height
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM italy_player_ids);

JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT
    disp.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - district.A11 AS gap
FROM client
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id     = client.client_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY
    client.birth_date ASC,     -- oldest first (earlier birth_date = older)
    district.A11 ASC           -- then lowest average salary
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'A'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
        FROM loan AS l2
        JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 12
          AND l2.status = 'A'
          AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   -
   SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp   AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia')
  AS crime_difference_1996;

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE disp.account_id = 130;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount,
       l.payments,
       l.status
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d   ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t   ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'          -- 'VYDAJ' = outgoing/expense transactions (money the client paid)
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT c.client_id,
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS num_students

JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT DISTINCT m.phone

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id)

JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event

WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_meetings
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN attendance AS a
        ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(e.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM attendance AS a
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a 
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e 
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
  AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount

WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id)

JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / SUM(b.amount),
        2
    ) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_members
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Meeting' 
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b  ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
JOIN event ev  ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finance_to_physics_ratio
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

SELECT 
    SUM(type = 'Community Service') * 100.0 / COUNT(event_id) AS percentage_community_service
FROM event
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31';

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.category,
    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip' AND member.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT m.major_name
FROM major m
JOIN member mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state

JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM expense e
JOIN member m 
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a 
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.approved = 'true'

SELECT email
FROM expense
JOIN member 
    ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major 
    ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member

SELECT DISTINCT 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e 
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT

    m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m 
    ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT CONCAT(m.first_name, ' ', m.last_name) AS full_name,
       ma.college
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    -- Percentage of superheroes whose alignment is 'Bad'
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(s.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,
    -- Number of 'Bad' superheroes published by Marvel Comics
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superpower AS sp
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS avg_no_skin_colour
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(s.weight_kg)

   WHERE s.full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(s.weight_kg)
   FROM superhero s
   WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE c.colour = 'blue'
  AND g.gender = 'male';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
