JOIN attribute 
    ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100
  AND T2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More in-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS comparison,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
            SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_pct
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T2.Date AS lab_date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_visit
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age_at_test
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(Symptoms) AS symptom_count
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY symptom_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_of_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(Examination.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(Patient.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes, within normal range'
        ELSE 'No, not within normal range'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.Date,
    L.TP,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    T1.Birthday, 
    T1.Description, 
    T1.`First Date`, 
    T1.Admission, 
    T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) = 1982;

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) T ON L.ID = T.ID AND L.Date = T.LatestDate
WHERE (L.UA < 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M')
   OR (L.UA < 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F');

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT P.ID AS Patient_ID,
       L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 
  AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t2.CRP = '+' AND t1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING MAX(T3."aCL IgA") = (
    SELECT MAX(T4."aCL IgA")
    FROM Examination AS T4
    JOIN Laboratory AS T5 ON T4.ID = T5.ID
    WHERE T5.CRE < 1.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'          -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'      -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

WITH double_bond_counts AS (
    -- Count double bonds per molecule
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
max_double_bonds AS (
    -- Find molecule(s) with the highest double bond count
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM double_bond_counts
    WHERE num_double_bonds = (SELECT MAX(num_double_bonds) FROM double_bond_counts)
)
-- Check whether that molecule is carcinogenic
SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM max_double_bonds mdb
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = mdb.molecule_id;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT T2.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(combo_cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_cnt
    FROM connected AS cn
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = cn.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = cn.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS combos;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR
        (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')
      );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE m.label
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
INNER JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes, carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'No, non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM atom
          WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM bond
          WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T2.Phone

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)

JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType

JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode

HAVING AVG(st.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

SELECT
  -- SME annual average minus LAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- LAM annual average minus KAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- KAM annual average minus SME annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- All 2013 consumption records of CZK-paying customers, with their segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers that hit the lowest consumption in their segment
    SELECT DISTINCT a.Segment,
                    a.CustomerID
    FROM czk_2013 AS a
    INNER JOIN min_per_segment AS m
            ON m.Segment = a.Segment
           AND a.Consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT a.Segment,
               a.CustomerID,
               SUM(a.Consumption) AS total_consumption
        FROM czk_2013 AS a
        INNER JOIN lowest_customers AS lc
                ON lc.Segment = a.Segment
               AND lc.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
        GROUP BY a.Segment, a.CustomerID
    ) AS z
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10,
        m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

WITH high_vision AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE vision > 89
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_3,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_6,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_7,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_8,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_9,  country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_10, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11, country_id FROM Match
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,
    c.name AS country
FROM high_vision hv
JOIN Player      p ON p.player_api_id = hv.player_api_id
JOIN appearances a ON a.player_api_id = hv.player_api_id
JOIN Country     c ON c.id = a.country_id;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M ON M.country_id = C.id
JOIN Player AS P ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC

FROM Player
WHERE height > 180

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id AS account_number,
    d.A11        AS lowest_average_salary,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp     ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM account
WHERE date LIKE '1993%'
  AND account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE duration > 12
          AND amount = (
                SELECT MAX(amount)
                FROM loan
                WHERE duration > 12
          )

FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'

SELECT account.date
FROM account

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    100.0 *
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district;

SELECT superhero_name, height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS bad_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T2.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(superhero.id) AS REAL) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE c.colour = 'blue' AND g.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS female_percentage
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_attribute.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
INNER JOIN attribute 
    ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT 
    MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
    - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination
  ) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms 
FROM Examination 
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
GROUP BY Symptoms 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT 
    JULIANDAY(MIN(E.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS Is_ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP, T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    L.Date AS Lab_Date,
    L.ALB,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982'
ORDER BY P.ID, L.Date;

SELECT AVG(t.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT l.ID, l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
    )
) t
JOIN Patient p ON t.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT 
    L.ID, 
    L.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 0 < T2.`U-PRO`
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') 
    AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T2.SM IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1."First Date")
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT
  ( SELECT COUNT(*)                                -- = SUM(bond_type = '-')
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'                            -- carcinogenic molecules
      AND b.bond_type = '-'                        -- single bonds
  ) * 1.0
  /
  ( SELECT COUNT(*)                                -- = COUNT(atom_id)
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'                            -- carcinogenic molecules
  ) AS average
;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY T1.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id),
    5
) AS proportion
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' 
   OR molecule_id = 'TR001' 
   OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, 
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151' 
  AND label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT
    -- SME's annual average - LAM's annual average
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'SME'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                                FROM yearmonth AS T3
                                JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                                WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                                  AND T4.Segment = 'SME'
                                  AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    )
    -
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                                FROM yearmonth AS T3
                                JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                                WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                                  AND T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                                  AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    ) AS diff_SME_LAM,

    -- LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                                FROM yearmonth AS T3
                                JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                                WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                                  AND T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                                  AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    )
    -
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'KAM'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                                FROM yearmonth AS T3
                                JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                                WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                                  AND T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                                  AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    ) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    -- KAM's annual average - SME's annual average
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'KAM'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                                FROM yearmonth AS T3
                                JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                                WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                                  AND T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                                  AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    )
    -
    (
        SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
        FROM yearmonth AS T1
        JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
        WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T2.Segment = 'SME'
          AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                            AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                          AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' 
                       AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER' 
                      THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)      AS total_paid,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' 
                                  AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER' 
                                 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp  d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan  l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992

  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1

WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(connected.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(element = 'c') / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b      ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1     ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'                     -- single bond
  AND m.label = '-'                         -- not carcinogenic
  AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id        -- both connected atoms
  AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id        -- belong to this molecule
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id 
                      FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'YES'
         ELSE 'NO'
       END
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' 
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's'
  AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a, molecule m
WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  AND m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom a2, molecule m2
        WHERE a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
          AND m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic

JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

WITH per_customer AS (
    -- Total consumption in 2013 for each CZK-paying customer
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the lowest-consumption customers:
    -- (total consumption per year) / (number of lowest-consumption customers)
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment
     AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_avg;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END)

JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
  );

SELECT

SELECT

    l.duration     AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - loan repaid without problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT repaid, debt outstanding'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments made OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client is in debt'

FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
