SELECT AVG(T2.UA)
FROM Patient T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND ((T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0)
    OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45 
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 
  AND L.IGG < 2000 
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%' 
  AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT Laboratory.ID 
      FROM Laboratory 
      WHERE Laboratory.C4 > 10
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) 
FROM Laboratory L 
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID 
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID
FROM Examination AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND t2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`) 
FROM Patient AS T2 
WHERE T2.ID = (
    SELECT T1.ID 
    FROM Laboratory AS T1 
    WHERE T1.LDH < 500 
    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(E2.`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination AS E2
      JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON E2.ID = L2.ID
      WHERE L2.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(T2.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(T3.atom_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id  FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS element1,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS element2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1     ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type  = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1      ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2      ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS counts;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) 
FROM atom AS a 
JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) = 2 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM atom
JOIN connected 
  ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND atom.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    bond.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT count(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 END) AS double_bond_count,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS C
JOIN atom AS A1 ON C.atom_id  = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE A1.element = 'cl'
  AND A2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM atom
          WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM bond
          WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T2.molecule_id, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT T2.molecule_id, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 
    ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 
    ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's'
  AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT m.molecule_id
        FROM molecule m
        WHERE m.label = '+'
      )
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
        SELECT MAX(t.cnt)
        FROM (
              SELECT COUNT(x.molecule_id) AS cnt
              FROM atom x
              WHERE x.molecule_id IN (
                      SELECT m2.molecule_id
                      FROM molecule m2
                      WHERE m2.label = '+'
                    )
              GROUP BY x.molecule_id
             ) t
       );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.District
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY AVG(st.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sc
    ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(sc.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.School LIKE '%High School%';

SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.DOCType
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS f1
      JOIN schools AS s1 ON f1.CDSCode = s1.CDSCode
      WHERE s1.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate_K12
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm 
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.MailStreet,
    T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport' 
  AND (T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (  (AdmFName1 = 'Mike'    AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
      OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike'    AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
      OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike'    AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson'))
  AND (  (AdmFName1 = 'Dante'   AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
      OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante'   AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
      OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante'   AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez'));

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City, 
    f.`Low Grade`, 
    s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(schools.School) AS num_schools,
       schools.City
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
  AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY schools.City;

SELECT 
    f.`District Code`,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' 
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' 
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL
  AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL
  AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT users.DisplayName AS Editor
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v

    SELECT UserId, NumComments
    FROM CommentCounts
    WHERE NumComments = (SELECT MAX(NumComments) FROM CommentCounts)
)

SELECT
    /* SME annual average - LAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_SME_LAM,

    /* LAM annual average - KAM annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    /* KAM annual average - SME annual average */
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1)
  -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
       FROM customers AS T1
       JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
      WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
      GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
      ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS diff_KAM_SME;

        M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
        M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country C
    ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name AS country
FROM Country c
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p         ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2
        JOIN match_players mp2 ON mp2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN Player p2         ON p2.player_api_id = mp2.player_api_id
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) t
);

FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT full_name
FROM superhero
WHERE weight_kg = 0
   OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superpower sp
JOIN hero_power hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN superhero sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
WHERE sh.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) * 1.0 /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT
    L.Date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age_At_First_Visit
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS AverageAge
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'
  AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID, COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
GROUP BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E
        ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                  + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    (l.TP - 8.5) AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Patient.Description,
    Patient."First Date",
    Patient.Admission,
    Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
        OR
        (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT  P.ID,
        L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
                   FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC   -- oldest = earliest birthday
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 
  AND l.IGG < 2000 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_female_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY bond_type
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id      = connected.bond_id
JOIN molecule  ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'          -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'      -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_molecule 
    ON top_molecule.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type  = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(num_bonds) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS has_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY element;

SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b     ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = '='
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom_id) AS atom_count

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer in each segment
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consuming customer(s) per segment:
    -- total consumption / number of customers with the lowest consumption
    SELECT 
        t.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals t
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON t.Segment = m.Segment 
       AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
  , 2) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) IN ('96', '97')

      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- Get the element pair for each bond
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS element1,
           a2.element AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds share each element combination
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)
SELECT 100.0 * bc.cnt / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts bc
WHERE bc.cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo_counts);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to customers paying in CZK
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(ym.Date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consumption customer(s) per segment
    -- = their total consumption / number of such customers
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON cz.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND cz.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

JOIN customers AS C ON Y.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
WHERE C.Currency = 'EUR';

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth AS y
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t
        ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
INNER JOIN products AS p
        ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE y.Date = '201309';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country
FROM gasstations AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE substr(T2.Date, 1, 6) = '201306';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT yearmonth.CustomerID)
FROM customers
JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND yearmonth.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306'
  AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS Total_Spent
FROM transactions_1k t
WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508
  AND t.Date = '201201';

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c 
    ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M
    ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE
             WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN 1
             ELSE 0
         END) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  )
  AND overall_rating > (
      SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 
          ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(Player_Attributes.long_shots) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(PA.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT T1.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND T1.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M 
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id 
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' 
  AND M.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT T2.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T1.birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT L.name 
FROM League AS L 
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id 
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT SUM(Match.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT T1.name
FROM Country AS T1
JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.country_id
WHERE T2.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT l.name AS league_name
FROM League l
JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) 
FROM Player AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' 
  AND substr(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        player_name, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS ranking
    FROM Player
) AS ranked_players
WHERE ranking = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
      M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,  M.home_player_5,
      M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,  M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10,
      M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
      M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,
      M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country AS C
  ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name AS Country
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M 
    ON M.country_id = C.id
JOIN Player AS P 
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
        M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10,
        M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9,
        M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_percentage_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp   ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) 
                      FROM client 
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT T1.date
FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.amount = 840
  AND T2.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d    ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t   ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d     ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'                        -- the account holder (owner)
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'                  -- client's region is East Bohemia
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- 'C' = running contract OK, 'D' = running contract, client in debt
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY total_active_loans DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT SUM(CASE 
             WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 
           END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_gold_cards_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM disp d
JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id  = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client   c  ON c.client_id   = d.client_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
    2
  ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
          AND c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.account_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount   AS debt_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid_1998
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' 
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(l.account_id) AS num_loan_accounts
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT DISTINCT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END AS more_common,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
