  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP >= 6.0
  AND L.TP <= 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'        -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'    -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
       5) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM connected AS cn
             JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = cn.atom_id
             JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = cn.atom_id2
             WHERE cn.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
               AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
                 OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl'))
         )
         THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c;

SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE m.label
           WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes, molecule TR151 is carcinogenic' 
         ELSE 'No, molecule TR151 is not carcinogenic' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes (carcinogenic)' 
        ELSE 'no (non-carcinogenic)' 
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS number_of_bond_types
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   AND a.element = 'o'
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id 
    OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
   AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.District,
    AVG(st.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc 
    ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Alameda (merged)'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname AS School_Name,
    sch.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Writing_Rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch 
    ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.County = 'Monterey';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS f2
        JOIN schools AS s2
            ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS FreeRate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey'
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(s.cds) AS total_schools
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'

SELECT County

WHERE SOC = 11

GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS s

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.City,
    T1.`Low Grade`,
    T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1

    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools AS s

WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'

SELECT 
    f.`District Code`,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f

SELECT

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount

SELECT
  -- Difference: SME - LAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- Difference: LAM - KAM
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- Difference: KAM - SME
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'

WHERE sh.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT T1.ID, year(current_timestamp) - year(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT MIN(L.`Date`)                                                AS lab_date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)              AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE UPPER(P.Diagnosis) = 'SJS'                 -- SJS patient
  AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday)         -- oldest = smallest birthday
                    FROM Patient
                    WHERE UPPER(Diagnosis) = 'SJS');

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', L.Date) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(T2.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.Date, 
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Out of normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON T.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS Latest
    ON T.ID = Latest.ID
   AND T.Date = Latest.latest_date
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900
  AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' 
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.ID NOT IN (
      SELECT E.ID
      FROM Examination E
      WHERE E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN L.ID END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 THEN L.ID END) * 1.0 AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis 
FROM Patient 
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE TG < 200 
    ORDER BY TG DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b      ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id     = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a      ON a.atom_id     = c.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom_1,
       a2.atom_id AS atom_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS combos;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(*), T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule  m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond      b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 
    ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 
    ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'o'
  AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T1.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.dname
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    satscores.sname AS School_Name,
    schools.CharterNum AS Charter_Number,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite AS Avg_Writing_Score
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores AS st
JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(st.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (

      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.DOC, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.MailStreet, satscores.sname
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport' 
  AND T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT Website 
FROM schools 
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike'

SELECT
  -- SME annual average minus LAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_SME_LAM,

  -- LAM annual average minus KAM annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_LAM_KAM,

  -- KAM annual average minus SME annual average
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                 / number of customers at that lowest level
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

      JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id

SELECT c.name AS country_name

WITH italian_matches AS (
    SELECT M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italian_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italian_matches
)

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts

        SELECT account_id 
        FROM loan
  );

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date (smaller birth_date = older)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among those oldest females, keep only the district with the lowest average salary
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM client
              WHERE gender = 'F'
                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                  FROM client
                                  WHERE gender = 'F')
        )
      );

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.date            AS loan_date,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in DEBT'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e  ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b   ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev   ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(event_id) AS percentage_share
FROM event
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31';

SELECT t_shirt_size

LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
INNER JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id, category, amount
FROM budget

                WHERE category = 'Food');

SELECT m.major_name

WHERE mem.first_name = 'Phillip'
  AND mem.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN major AS T2 
    ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' 
    AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM major
JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
