JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    district_id AS branch_location, 
    A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_high_level_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
     * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INT) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT 
    loan.loan_id,
    loan.amount AS debt_amount,
    loan.payments,
    loan.duration,
    loan.status
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE client.client_id = 992
  AND loan.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_account_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id)
FROM event AS T1
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
  AND T1.event_id IN (
      SELECT T2.link_to_event
      FROM attendance AS T2
      GROUP BY T2.link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_exceeded_budgets
FROM budget
INNER JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / SUM(b.amount) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_members
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget  b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event   ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS ratio
FROM member AS T1
JOIN major AS T2
    ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id;

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b 
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.category,
    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id, category, amount
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
  AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount)
                FROM budget
                WHERE category = 'Food');

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip'
  AND member.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT type 
FROM event 
WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS x   ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e      ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE x.approved = 'true'
  AND x.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > 20
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(member.member_id) AS member_count
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS e
INNER JOIN member AS m
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
INNER JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
INNER JOIN event AS ev
    ON ev.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY MAX(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    T1.first_name, 
    T1.last_name, 
    T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 
    ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT mj.major_name, mj.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major mj ON mem.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT 
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj 
    ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
GROUP BY superhero.full_name
HAVING COUNT(superhero.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c_eye.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
WHERE c_skin.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name, 
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha 
    ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END)  AS num_inpatients,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)  AS num_outpatients,
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END)
          / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT
    MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
    - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date,
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age_at_first_visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.ID IN (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4'
  AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS days_until_first_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298
GROUP BY p.ID, p.`First Date`;

SELECT T1.ID, 
       CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.[First Date], P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    P.Birthday,
    L.Date,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALB_Normal
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS avg_ua_index
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = P.ID
      )
  AND ( (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5) );

SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.SEX,
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory
    ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')) AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT  P.ID,
        L.`T-CHO`
FROM    Patient AS P
        INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
            ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE   L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.`SC170` IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P."First Date")
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
      AND L.LDH = (
          SELECT MAX(LDH)
          FROM Laboratory
          WHERE LDH < 500
      )
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 
  AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(T4.`aCL IgA`) 
      FROM Examination AS T4 
      JOIN Laboratory AS T5 ON T4.ID = T5.ID 
      WHERE T5.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND T1."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.atom_id,
       a2.atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom     AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom     AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule AS m  ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
        / COUNT(molecule_id),
        3
    ) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    c.atom_id, 
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb';

WITH element_pairs AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS elem1,
           a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM element_pairs
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),
top_combo AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, cnt
    FROM combo_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
         top_combo.cnt * 100.0 /
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond),
       2) AS percentage
FROM top_combo;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS has_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS t1
JOIN atom AS t2 ON t1.atom_id  = t2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS t3 ON t1.atom_id2 = t3.atom_id
WHERE t1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((t2.element = 'cl' AND t3.element = 'c')
    OR (t2.element = 'c'  AND t3.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' 
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       m.label          AS carcinogenic_label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) 
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T3.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
                 OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'o' AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    `frpm`.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `frpm`.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM `frpm`
INNER JOIN `schools` 
    ON `frpm`.`CDSCode` = `schools`.`CDSCode`
WHERE `schools`.`SOCType` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s
  ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.cds) AS num_schools
FROM schools AS sc
INNER JOIN satscores AS s
    ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sc.County = 'Alameda'
  AND sc.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND s.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    satscores.sname,
    satscores.dname,
    satscores.cname,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite,
    schools.CharterNum
FROM satscores
JOIN schools 
    ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores AS st
JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School
HAVING AVG(st.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.`School`   AS School_Name,
    s.`Street`,
    s.`City`,
    s.`State`,
    s.`Zip`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`CDSCode`
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.`GSserved` = '9-12';

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm AS f2
        WHERE f2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
      );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Free_Rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(sat.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', sch.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sch.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch 
    ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet, sc.sname
FROM satscores AS sc
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (
        (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
     OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
     OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
      )
  AND (
        (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
     OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
     OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
      );

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.Charter = 0
  AND T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_directly_funded_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT 
    s.County
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.SOC = 11

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Minimum total consumption within each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    -- Customers whose consumption equals the segment's minimum
    SELECT 
        ct.Segment, 
        ct.total_consumption
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm 
        ON  ct.Segment = sm.Segment
        AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH oldest_female_clients AS (
    -- Step 1: female clients with the earliest birth_date (= oldest)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (
            SELECT MIN(birth_date)
            FROM client
            WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
),
lowest_salary AS (
    -- Step 2: among those oldest females, the lowest average salary (A11) of their districts
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_salary
    FROM oldest_female_clients c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
)
-- Step 3: their account numbers + gap vs. the highest average salary overall
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary) AS gap
FROM oldest_female_clients c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary);

        * 100.0

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.date                          AS loan_date,
    l.amount                        AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                      AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished - loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'running - client in DEBT'
    END                             AS payment_status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 0
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount
        ELSE MAX(0,
             l.amount - l.payments *
             CAST((julianday('1999-01-01') - julianday(l.date)) / 30.44 AS INTEGER))
    END                             AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992

FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    -- Percentage of superheroes with 'Bad' alignment
    ROUND(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN al.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,
    -- Count of 'Bad' superheroes published by Marvel Comics
    COUNT(CASE WHEN al.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment al ON s.alignment_id = al.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p  ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT s.power_name
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS s ON hp.power_id = s.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  );

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
        * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percent_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT 
    a.alignment, 
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a 
    ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp 
    ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE c.colour = 'blue'
  AND g.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger among male patients
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common,
    -- Deviation in percentage: (male in-patients / male outpatients) * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) - MIN(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT
    L.Date AS lab_completion_date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(P.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_when_first_arrived
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT e.`aCL IgM` AS anti_cardiolipin_status
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Date) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA = '8.4'
  AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2)
        FROM Examination
        WHERE Thrombosis = 2
          AND ANA = 'S'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(julianday(Examination.`Examination Date`) - julianday(Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Description,
    P.`First Date`,
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS 'Albumin Within Normal Range'
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p 
    ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest 
    ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.MaxDate
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    P.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID,
       L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (
        SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
        FROM Laboratory
      )
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000
    
    INTERSECT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT ID 
    FROM Examination 
    WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E

WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) AS First_Recorded_Date
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON atom.molecule_id  = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id      = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a.atom_id, 
       a.element, 
       a2.atom_id AS atom_id2, 
       a2.element AS element2, 
       m.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a  ON c.atom_id  = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT 
    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- One row per bond: the (unordered) pair of elements of its two atoms
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.bond_id,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_lo,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS elem_hi
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds have each element combination
    SELECT elem_lo, elem_hi, COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem_lo, elem_hi
)
-- Hint: DIVIDE( count of bonds in the MAX group , total number of bonds )
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS pct_most_common_combo
FROM combo_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(b.bond_id),
           5
       ) AS proportion_of_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond
JOIN atom ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 
         THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS has_both_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, limited to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customers
    --                 / number of those customers
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment,
           SUM(ca.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_annual ca
    JOIN min_cons mc
      ON ca.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND ca.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption of every CZK-paying customer, with their segment
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS yearly_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Keep only the customer(s) with the lowest 2013 consumption in each segment,
    -- then total their consumption and count them
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.yearly_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(z.CustomerID)       AS n_customers
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, MIN(yearly_consumption) AS min_consumption
        FROM czk_2013
        GROUP BY Segment
    ) AS m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT Segment,
           CAST(total_consumption AS REAL) / n_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_per_segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH loan_months AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        -- Months elapsed since the loan was issued (SQLite-compatible)
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12
        + (CAST(strftime('%m', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)) AS months_elapsed
    FROM loan l
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    m.loan_id,
    m.amount                                              AS loan_amount,
    m.payments                                            AS monthly_payment,
    m.duration                                            AS loan_duration_months,
    m.date                                                AS loan_issue_date,
    m.months_elapsed                                      AS months_since_issue,
    MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration)                     AS payments_made,
    MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration) * m.payments        AS total_paid_so_far,
    -- Estimated remaining debt
    m.amount - MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration) * m.payments AS remaining_debt,
    -- Payment performance based on the loan status code
    CASE m.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client in debt'
    END                                                   AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d       ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan_months m ON m.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;
