WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2
  ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'More in-patients' 
        ELSE 'More outpatients' 
    END AS comparison,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
    2) AS percentage_deviation
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, 
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' 
    AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count,
       ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS days_difference
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    Laboratory.ID,
    Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation_of_TP_from_normal
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' 
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Not within normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE T.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T2
        WHERE T2.ID = T.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F')) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT 
    L.ID,
    L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY 
    L."T-CHO" DESC,   -- highest total cholesterol first
    P.Birthday ASC    -- among ties, pick the earliest birthday (oldest)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
INNER JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ana_level
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON atom.molecule_id      = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id     = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id          = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element AS element1, T3.element AS element2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    bond.bond_type, 
    connected.atom_id, 
    connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected AS c2
        JOIN atom AS a1 ON c2.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ) AS t
);

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(element) = 2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND T2.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule 
    ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE m.label 
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenicity
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '=' AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    T2.School,
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.cname = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T1.sname,
    T2.CharterNum,
    T1.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores AS T1

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                 / number of customers at that lowest level
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT SUM(TA2.chanceCreationPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(TA2.id)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND TA2.date <= '2014-12-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

    SELECT M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches

    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts

        FROM loan
  );

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date (smaller birth_date = older)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among those oldest females, keep only the district with the lowest average salary
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM client
              WHERE gender = 'F'
                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                  FROM client
                                  WHERE gender = 'F')
        )
      );

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.date            AS loan_date,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in DEBT'

SELECT m.major_name

SELECT m.position

SELECT event_name

SELECT DISTINCT

FROM expense AS ex

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT 
    SUM(ex.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense ex
JOIN member m  ON ex.link_to_member  = m.member_id
JOIN budget b  ON ex.link_to_budget  = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev  ON b.link_to_event    = ev.event_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member

ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 
    ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT 
    major.major_name,
    major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1

GROUP BY T2.hero_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero

WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT
    -- Percentage of superheroes whose alignment is 'Bad'
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(s.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,
    -- Count of those 'Bad' superheroes published by Marvel Comics
    SUM(
        CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS marvel_comics_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(CASE WHEN skin_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female_marvel
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT

    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a

JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero

JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Brown'
  AND s.weight_kg < 100;

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT L.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(L.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS Original_Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_first_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.ALP,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
                  THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 / 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 
                  THEN Patient.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
  AND T2.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b       ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1      ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2      ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT

        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND ym.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Monthly consumption records of CZK customers in 2013
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value per segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of customers
    -- with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.Consumption) / COUNT(cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON cz.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND cz.Consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger?
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'In-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'Outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS larger_group,

    -- Raw counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,

    -- Deviation in percentage: (in-patients / outpatients) * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS deviation_percentage,

    -- Percentage point difference relative to outpatients
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS deviation_percent_diff
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Description,
    P.[First Date],
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS albumin_status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(latest.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, Date, UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
) latest ON p.ID = latest.ID
WHERE latest.rn = 1
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND latest.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND latest.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' 
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0) 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS YoungestBirthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT l.ID
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY e.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule  ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN A.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(A.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom A
WHERE A.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT B.molecule_id
    FROM bond B
    WHERE B.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') 
    - 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    c.atom_id, 
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS bonded_atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT c.atom_id AS bonded_atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(pair_counts.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS pair_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_pct
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES' 
         ELSE 'NO' 
       END AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')
      );

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT
    atom.element,
    COUNT(*) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'              -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'  -- only the 4th atom of each molecule
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes, carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'No, not carcinogenic'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
INNER JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS number_of_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.School) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' 
    AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
    AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T2.CharterNum,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS `Rank`
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode, T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS f2
      JOIN schools AS s2 
          ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.MailStreet
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s 
    ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 
OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
MinConsumption AS (
    -- The least amount of consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestCustomers AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN MinConsumption mc
        ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
       AND cc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinConsumption
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM LowestCustomers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE 
           WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
           WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'

       END AS higher_year

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)

   SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
