SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT 
    a.alignment,
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a 
    ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp 
    ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' 
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100
  AND T2.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
    / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA = '8.4'
  AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_elapsed
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    l.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(T1.SEX = 'M') > SUM(T1.SEX = 'F') 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT
    L.ID       AS patient_id,
    L."T-CHO"  AS t_cho
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.SYMPTOMS IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS Percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS First_Recorded_Date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination AS T3
      INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.atom_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T2.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'        -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'    -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT B.bond_type, C.atom_id, C.atom_id2
FROM bond AS B
JOIN connected AS C ON B.bond_id = C.bond_id
WHERE B.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS total
FROM atom
JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT atom.molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE atom.element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule.molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT bond.molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected 
    ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond 
    ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_with_triple_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY Eligible_Free_Rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.District, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Consumption records of CZK customers in 2013 (first 4 chars of Date = year)
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
lowest AS (
    -- Lowest consumption per segment for 2013
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption at the lowest level / number of customers at that level
    SELECT k.Segment,
           SUM(k.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(k.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 k
    JOIN lowest l
      ON k.Segment = l.Segment
     AND k.Consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY k.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    total_loan_amount,
    monthly_payment,
    duration,
    status,
    CASE
        WHEN total_loan_amount - monthly_payment * months_elapsed > 0
            THEN total_loan_amount - monthly_payment * months_elapsed
        ELSE 0
    END AS outstanding_debt
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount        AS total_loan_amount,
        l.payments      AS monthly_payment,
        l.duration,
        l.status,
        -- months elapsed since loan was taken (SQLite-compatible)
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date)   AS INTEGER)) * 12
        + (CAST(strftime('%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date)   AS INTEGER)) AS months_elapsed
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d   ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id = 992
);

SELECT

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT

SELECT T2.city

SELECT T1.full_name

SELECT T1.superhero_name

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT T1.power_name

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1)

SELECT superhero.height_cm

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT p.publisher_name

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name

SELECT T1.superhero_name

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race

SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height

SELECT T1.hero_id

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_outpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, 
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       CAST(SUBSTR(T2.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
       CAST(SUBSTR(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS Age_at_First_Arrival
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
     / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4' 
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'

        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE 
           WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    L.ID,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.*
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.Date,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Not within normal range'
    END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT T2.ID, T2.UA, T2.Date, T3.SEX
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID
    WHERE T2.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T4.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T4
        WHERE T4.ID = T2.ID
    )
) AS T1
WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M')
        FROM Patient
        JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
        WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5)
     >
       (SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
        FROM Patient
        JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
        WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5) AS Answer;

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 45
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0

  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T3.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T2
WHERE T2.ID = (
    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T1
    WHERE T1.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT T1.ID

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a       ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b       ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
    OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1, a2.atom_id AS atom2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK customers
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    -- The lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption
    -- customer(s) / number of those customers, per segment
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total

        FROM client

  -- among those oldest females, keep only the one(s) with the lowest average salary (A11)

        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id

             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WITH annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT a.Segment, SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS annual_average
    FROM annual_consumption a
    JOIN segment_min m ON m.Segment = a.Segment AND m.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, y.CustomerID AS cid, y.Consumption AS cons
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segmin AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(cons) AS minc
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY seg
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT z.seg, z.cid
    FROM czk AS z
    JOIN segmin AS m ON m.seg = z.seg AND m.minc = z.cons
),
annual AS (
    SELECT seg, cid, SUM(cons) AS total
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY seg, cid
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT l.seg AS seg, SUM(a.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS av
    FROM lowest AS l
    JOIN annual AS a ON a.seg = l.seg AND a.cid = l.cid
    GROUP BY l.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT av FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80

SELECT race.race FROM superhero INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id WHERE gender.gender = 'Male' AND colour.colour = 'Blue'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 2
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND T3.race <> 'Human'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT superhero.full_name FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE superhero.weight_kg < 100 AND colour.colour = 'brown'
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
INNER JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT ID, SEX, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB < 3.5)
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)
SELECT T1.Date, strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT CAST(SUBSTR('1991-10-21', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.UA = '8.4' AND L.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.`First Date` = '1997-01-27'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Birthday LIKE '1964%' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2 FROM Examination)
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "Description", "Diagnosis" FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.SEX = 'M' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' AND T2.Admission = '-'
SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(T1.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS DATEDIFF FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE date(T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT T2.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5
SELECT * FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5));
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE SEX = 'M' AND CRE >= 1.5) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE SEX = 'F' AND CRE >= 1.5);
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory."T-CHO"
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2 AND L.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0 AND T2.SM IN ('negative', '0')
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(Patient.ID) * 1.0 FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(T1."First Date") FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T4.element FROM connected AS T3 JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id, bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c1
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT c2.atom_id
FROM connected AS c2
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a2.element = 'pb'

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND ((T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c') OR (T2.element = 'c' AND T3.element = 'cl'))
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT count(a.element) FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
SELECT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS t1 JOIN atom AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id JOIN bond AS t3 ON t1.molecule_id = t3.molecule_id WHERE t2.element = 's' AND t3.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T2.District FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T2.District ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.CharterNum, satscores.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.sname
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND f."School Type" LIKE '%High Schools%'

SELECT School, DOCType
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'local'
  AND CDSCode IN (
      SELECT CDSCode
      FROM frpm
      WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
          SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
          FROM frpm
          WHERE CDSCode IN (
              SELECT CDSCode
              FROM schools
              WHERE FundingType = 'local'
          )
      )
  )

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = '1'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS p
    JOIN min_seg AS m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT AVG(T.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T JOIN race AS R ON T.race_id = R.id JOIN publisher AS P ON T.publisher_id = P.id WHERE R.race <> 'Human' AND P.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(hero_id) FROM hero_attribute AS ha JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown'
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT CASE
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
         THEN 'in-patient'
         ELSE 'outpatient'
       END AS more,
       ROUND(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
             / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

SELECT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT T1.Date, (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T1.`aCL IgM` FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4' AND L.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT T3.SEX FROM Patient AS T3 JOIN Examination AS T1 ON T3.ID = T1.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T2.CRP > 2 AND T2.CRE = 1 AND T2.LDH = 123
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT "First Date", Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T1.Diagnosis LIKE 'Behcet%' AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT JULIANDAY("Examination Date") - JULIANDAY("First Date") FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5))
  AND L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX

SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC, P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450)
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" >= 30)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT e.ID FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.GOT >= 60 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T1.ID END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.GOT >= 60 THEN T1.ID END) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.`First Date` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '+'

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS t

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id 
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
        OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS result

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' 
GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id 
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id OR atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS rate FROM frpm WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY rate ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.School FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 500 AND s.Magnet = 1
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500
SELECT s.District FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY s.District ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores T1 JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS ranking FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT s."School", s."Street", s."City", s."State", s."Zip" FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" - frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > ( SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' )

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson') OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson') OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = 31 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" = ( SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.DOC = 31 )
SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
