WITH cust_totals AS ( SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment ), min_seg AS ( SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption FROM cust_totals GROUP BY Segment ), segment_avg AS ( SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM cust_totals ct JOIN min_seg m ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_consumption GROUP BY ct.Segment ) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_cust AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(DISTINCT z.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.Consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_cust
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH bond_elem AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id AS bond_id, a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2
  FROM connected AS c
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  GROUP BY c.bond_id
),
combo AS (
  SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond_elem
  GROUP BY e1, e2
)

FROM combo
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo)

    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_sal
    FROM district d
    JOIN oldest_f o ON d.district_id = o.district_id
)

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS TEXT) LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_consumption,
               MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_c
        FROM czk
    ) t
    WHERE total_consumption = min_c
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
      * 100.0
      / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem_pair
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
most_common AS (
    SELECT elem_pair
    FROM pairs
    GROUP BY elem_pair
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM pairs
WHERE elem_pair = (SELECT elem_pair FROM most_common);

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, ym.CustomerID AS cust, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.seg AS seg, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.cust) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.seg = m.seg AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minima m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH match_players AS (
  SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name
FROM (
  SELECT mp.country_id, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
  FROM match_players mp
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
  GROUP BY mp.country_id
) a
JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
ORDER BY a.avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_c
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, SUM(y.total_consumption) AS tot, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN mincons m ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_c
    GROUP BY y.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, tot * 1.0 / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

       (SELECT Consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201') AS january_2012_spent

SELECT T1.CustomerID, SUM(T2.Price) / SUM(T2.Amount), T1.Currency
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
GROUP BY T1.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name, height FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010' AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010') ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T1.long_shots) / COUNT(T1.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_fifa_api_id = T2.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT SUM(chanceCreationPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(id)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p

WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T1.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T1.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON pa.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country
FROM (
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_2 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_3 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_4 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_5 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_6 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_7 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_8 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_9 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_10 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_11 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_1 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_2 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_3 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_4 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_5 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_6 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_7 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_8 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_9 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_10 FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_11 FROM Match m
) cp
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = cp.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = cp.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 12);

FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840 AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id

FROM account a

JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id

FROM card;

SELECT c.type

JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_of_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;
SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id WHERE disp.account_id = 130 AND disp.type = 'OWNER'

FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

WITH PerCustomer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalCons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalCons) AS MinCons
    FROM PerCustomer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AvgPerSegment AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment, SUM(p.TotalCons) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM PerCustomer p
    JOIN MinPerSegment m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.TotalCons = m.MinCons
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AvgPerSegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, y.Consumption AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_con
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment AS Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_con
    FROM czk2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_con
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_con FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    SELECT m.*
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

FROM client c

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

               FROM client c2

SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'Human';
SELECT sp.power_name FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE sc.colour = 'Gold';
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT id FROM race WHERE race = 'Vampire');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler');
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_power AS T1 JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'In-patient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END, SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT p.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.RVVT = '+'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12'
SELECT P.SEX FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID FROM Examination AS T2 WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27')
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Birthday LIKE '1964%' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Admission = '-'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
SELECT julianday((SELECT MIN("Examination Date") FROM Examination WHERE ID = 821298)) - julianday("First Date") FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 AS `ALP within normal range` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN Patient.ID END) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN Patient.ID END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY l."T-CHO" DESC, p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 45 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT "ID" FROM "Examination" WHERE "Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND "SC170" IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.GOT >= 60
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(P."First Date") FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.ID = (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.LDH < 500 ORDER BY L.LDH DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE < 1.5
  AND Examination."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND T1."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)) = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT printf('%.5f', SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id))
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected AS T2
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND T1.element IN ('cl', 'c')

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT element, COUNT(element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY element

SELECT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl') OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl');

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT a1.molecule_id FROM atom a1 JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation Education' AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT schools.Phone FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500
SELECT s.District FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY s.District ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda' AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT schools.CharterNum, satscores.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

SELECT schools.School, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.State, schools.Zip
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Monterey'
  AND frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND frpm.`School Type` = 'High Schools';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
AND T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" >
(SELECT AVG(T3."Enrollment (K-12)" - T3."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
FROM frpm AS T3
INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           c.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment,
               total_consumption,
               MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_cons
        FROM totals
    )
    WHERE total_consumption = min_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT superhero.id FROM superhero INNER JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient, SUM(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT Patient.ID, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200

SELECT T1.Date, CAST(SUBSTR(T2.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.ID IN (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30')
SELECT E."aCL IgM" FROM Examination AS E JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND P.Description = '1994-02-19' AND E."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12';
SELECT p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GPT = '9' AND l.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Examination.`Thrombosis` = 2 AND Examination.`ANA` = 'S' AND Examination.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Patient.Description, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE Patient.ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1980' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
SELECT JULIANDAY(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(Laboratory.LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT * FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC

SELECT Patient.ID, CASE WHEN Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS NormalRange
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID) AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5))

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY Patient.SEX
SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO" FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory) ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND Laboratory.FG IS NOT NULL AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) FROM Examination JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT e.ID FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T2."First Date") FROM Patient AS T2 WHERE T2.ID = (SELECT T1.ID FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.`Examination Date` FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY T2.ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5 AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5 AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX(T1."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T1)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND T2."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM bond AS b INNER JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (SELECT bond.molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '=')
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id IN (SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9')
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY atom.element ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule m

SELECT ROUND(SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule m;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND molecule.molecule_id IN (SELECT bond.molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '-') ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT bond.bond_type FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond.bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT a.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT atom.element FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT molecule.label = '+' FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom WHERE atom.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT connected.atom_id FROM connected) AND atom.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT connected.atom_id2 FROM connected)
SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY b.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb' UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT CAST(MAX(cnt) AS REAL) / SUM(cnt)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM molecule WHERE molecule.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT b.bond_id, m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY a.element
SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'ca'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(bond.bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151' AND m.label = '+') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT bond.molecule_id FROM bond JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT a.atom_id FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T2 JOIN connected AS T1 ON T2.bond_id = T1.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation Education' ORDER BY T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T1.dname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T1.dname ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T2.CharterNum, T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND f."School Type" LIKE 'High%';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE (T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson' AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez' OR AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson' AND AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez' OR AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez' AND AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson' OR AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez' AND AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson' OR AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson' AND AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez' OR AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez' AND AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Charter = 0 AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = '11' AND substr(ClosedDate, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT czk2013.Segment, SUM(czk2013.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk2013
    JOIN mins ON czk2013.Segment = mins.Segment AND czk2013.total_consumption = mins.min_consumption
    GROUP BY czk2013.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH consumption AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_customers AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(c.total_consumption) AS total_cons, COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM consumption c
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.total_consumption = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_cons * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM least_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cons2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cons2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgcons AS (
    SELECT b.Segment,
           CAST(SUM(b.total_consumption) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cons2013 b
    JOIN mincons m
      ON b.Segment = m.Segment AND b.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY b.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgcons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(c.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM consumption c
    JOIN lowest l ON c.Segment = l.Segment AND c.TotalConsumption = l.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Difference_KAM_SME

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mintotal
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avgc
  FROM totals t

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minseg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal FROM totals GROUP BY Segment
),
avgseg AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avgCons
  FROM totals t
  JOIN minseg m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgCons FROM avgseg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN lowest AS l ON l.Segment = t.Segment AND l.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
