SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id = 75;
SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND colour.colour = 'No Colour';
SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND LOWER(r.race) = 'human';
SELECT sp.power_name FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'
SELECT c2.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler');
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE LOWER(colour.colour) = 'blue' AND LOWER(gender.gender) = 'male'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) FROM superhero INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS s ON hp.power_id = s.id WHERE s.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 1) * 100
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE CAST(l.ALB AS REAL) < 3.5
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(TG AS REAL) >= 200);

SELECT MAX(T1.`Date`) AS `Date`, CAST(SUBSTR(T2.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS')
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T1."aCL IgM" FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T1."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'
SELECT p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.Date = '1992-06-12' AND l.GPT = '9'

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', Laboratory.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';
SELECT T1."Diagnosis" FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27' AND T2."Diagnosis" = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Patient.Admission = '-' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' AND Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'

SELECT CAST(julianday(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - julianday(p."First Date") AS INTEGER) AS days
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p."Birthday" FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY p."Birthday" DESC;
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Normal FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(CAST(l.UA AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND l.UA IS NOT NULL AND l.UA != ''
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) < 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.UN < 30;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F') FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE >= 1.5);
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT l."ID", l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0 AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination E WHERE E.ID = L.ID AND E.KCT = '+')
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE CAST(l.RF AS INTEGER) < 20 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(P.ID AS TEXT) AS ID
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Examination AS E
        WHERE CAST(E.ID AS TEXT) = CAST(P.ID AS TEXT)
          AND E."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS L
        WHERE CAST(L.ID AS TEXT) = CAST(P.ID AS TEXT)
          AND LOWER(TRIM(CAST(L.SC170 AS TEXT))) IN ('negative', '0')
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 THEN 1 END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.ID = (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.LDH < 500 ORDER BY L.LDH DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T3 JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(a.element = 'c') / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY m.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE TRIM(bond_type) = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE TRIM(m.label) = '+' AND TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;
SELECT DISTINCT m.label FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'ca';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT a.molecule_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';
SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T3.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS cnt FROM atom JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY atom.molecule_id ) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = '='
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT T1."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOC = 65 ORDER BY T1."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500 AND sch.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT s.District FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY s.District ORDER BY AVG(sat.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip

WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),

    SELECT f.client_id, d.A11
    FROM oldest_female f
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = f.district_id
),
target AS (
    SELECT os.client_id, os.A11
    FROM oldest_salary os
    WHERE os.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM oldest_salary)
)

SELECT

JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg,
           COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS n,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS tot
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'SME')
      - (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS [SME_minus_LAM],
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS [LAM_minus_KAM],
    (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT tot * 1.0 / n FROM totals WHERE seg = 'SME') AS [KAM_minus_SME];

SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';
SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_inpatient,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_outpatient,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT l.Date, strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'
SELECT p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GPT = '9' AND l.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';
SELECT p.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(e."Examination Date") - JULIANDAY(p."First Date") AS days
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298
ORDER BY e."Examination Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       L.ALB,
       CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS AlbuminInNormalRange
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P."Birthday") = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)
FROM Laboratory t1
JOIN Examination t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND t2.KCT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient AS P 
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 AND T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) 
FROM Laboratory l 
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID 
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T1.element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.atom_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT c.bond_id, MIN(a1.element || '-' || a2.element) AS element_combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
)
GROUP BY element_combo
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT T1.bond_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM bond AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT count(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';
SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT "CDSCode" FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(*) FROM satscores T1 JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT satscores.sname, satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.CharterNum
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T3."Charter Funding Type"
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
JOIN frpm AS T3 ON T2.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f
      JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
      WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT F.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / F.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm F
JOIN schools S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode
WHERE (S.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (S.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (S.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`CDSCode`
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)

WITH cust_tot AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_tot
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_tot AS ct
    JOIN seg_min AS sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total = sm.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cc AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS tc
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN czk c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mn AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(tc) AS mtc
    FROM cc
    GROUP BY Segment
),
low AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, SUM(cc.tc) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM cc
    JOIN mn ON cc.Segment = mn.Segment AND cc.tc = mn.mtc
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
),
av AS (
    SELECT Segment, total * 1.0 / cnt AS avgc
    FROM low
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgc FROM av WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH percust AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segmin AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM percust
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgmin AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment, SUM(p.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM percust p
    JOIN segmin s ON p.Segment = s.Segment AND p.total = s.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgmin WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH cust_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.total_consumption
    FROM cust_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
annual_average AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) = 1982

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID AS "Patient ID", L."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC, P.Birthday ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 THEN Laboratory.ID END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(P."First Date")
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.LDH AS REAL) < 500
  AND CAST(L.LDH AS REAL) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(LDH AS REAL)) FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(LDH AS REAL) < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id)

JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR004_8_9');

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule

JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'

LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.atom_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

    SELECT 1
    FROM connected co
    JOIN atom a1 ON co.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON co.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE co.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
        OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS result;
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'ca')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151' AND label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')
SELECT bond.molecule_id FROM bond JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.label = 'TR006'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'
SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.molecule_id FROM atom AS t1 JOIN bond AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t1.element = 's' AND t2.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'Continuation')
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'

ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T3.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode WHERE T3.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T3.FundingType HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s."School", s."Street", s."City", s."State", s."Zip"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND f."School Type" LIKE 'High%';

SELECT T2.`School Name`, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE (T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson') OR (T2.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson') OR (T2.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City

JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT s.School FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = '31' ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sname, MailStreet FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND date(OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) AS sum_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) = (

        JOIN atom a3 ON c2.atom_id = a3.atom_id
        JOIN atom a4 ON c2.atom_id2 = a4.atom_id

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
  SELECT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
);

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID,
           L.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS L
) AS T
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = T.ID
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalLow, COUNT(*) AS NumLow
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalLow) * 1.0 / SUM(NumLow) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

   / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
