SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT L.ID FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.ALB < 3.5)
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.TG >= 200

SELECT T1.Date, (CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC, T1.Date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(NULLIF(l.UA, '') AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(NULLIF(l.UA, '') AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21' AND Laboratory.UA = '8.4';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
      AND Admission = '+'
    ORDER BY ID
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2 FROM Examination)
SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX FROM Patient AS P JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND L.CRP > 2 AND L.CRE = 1 AND L.LDH = 123
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - JULIANDAY(p."First Date") AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.Date, Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday, Patient.Description, Patient.[First Date], Patient.Admission, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA, P.SEX,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.ID ORDER BY L.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
) T
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY P.SEX

SELECT l."ID", l."T-CHO"
FROM "Laboratory" l
JOIN "Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM "Laboratory")
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."U-PRO" >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0
  AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND p.SEX = 'F' AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `Patient`.`ID`)
FROM `Patient`
JOIN `Laboratory` ON `Patient`.`ID` = `Laboratory`.`ID`
WHERE `Laboratory`.`SSA` IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', `Patient`.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5 AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5 AND Laboratory.TP >= 6.0 AND Laboratory.TP <= 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination AS T3
      INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type HAVING COUNT(bond_id) = (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(a.element = 'c') / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
) d ON a.molecule_id = d.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'

WITH top_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT element
FROM top_elements
ORDER BY element;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT (SELECT m.label FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id = (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY b.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)) = '+';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT b.bond_id, c.atom_id, a1.element AS element1, c.atom_id2, a2.element AS element2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
LEFT JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
LEFT JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM bond JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));
SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2 FROM bond JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element
SELECT T1.molecule_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b INNER JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.molecule_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'c';
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T2.District FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T2.District ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100
SELECT T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
);

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(CAST(ym.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, pc.total_consumption
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN segment_min sm ON pc.Segment = sm.Segment AND pc.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

       CASE l.status

           WHEN 'C' THEN 'Loan running, payments made on time'
           WHEN 'D' THEN 'Loan running, client in debt'

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    SELECT DISTINCT M.country_id, P.player_api_id

WITH avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH bond_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id, a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.atom_id <= c.atom_id2
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
    FROM bond_pairs
    GROUP BY e1, e2
),
top_pair AS (
    SELECT num_bonds
    FROM pair_counts
    ORDER BY num_bonds DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST(num_bonds AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM top_pair;

JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1' AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS is_carcinogenic;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(bond.bond_type) FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY atom.atom_id

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    AS Difference_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    AS Difference_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
    AS Difference_KAM_SME;

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS element1,
        CASE WHEN a1.element > a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS element2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT
        element1,
        element2,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
)

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

   - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')

WHERE SEX = 'M'

)

ORDER BY u.Id, b.Date;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) AS sum_low,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt_low
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_low * 1.0 / cnt_low AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

    FROM Match

),

    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_matches

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_matches
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_matches

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_matches

),

WITH oldest AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_bd
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
sel AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, d.A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date = (SELECT min_bd FROM oldest)
      AND d.A11 = (
            SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
            FROM client c2
            JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
            WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
              AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT min_bd FROM oldest)
      )
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - s.A11 AS gap
FROM sel s
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = s.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2) IN ('96', '97');

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

            M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.CustomerID, t.total_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avgs;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.date AS loan_date,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Finished - no problems, no debt'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Finished - loan not paid, debt remains'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status IN ('B', 'D') THEN
            MAX(0,
                l.amount - l.payments *
                CASE
                    WHEN (julianday((SELECT MAX(date) FROM trans)) - julianday(l.date)) / 30.0 >= l.duration
                        THEN l.duration
                    ELSE CAST((julianday((SELECT MAX(date) FROM trans)) - julianday(l.date)) / 30.0 AS INTEGER)
                END
            )
        ELSE 0
    END AS outstanding_debt,
    COALESCE(t.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid_via_transactions,
    COALESCE(t.n_payments, 0) AS payment_transactions_made
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_paid, COUNT(*) AS n_payments
    FROM trans
    WHERE k_symbol = 'UVER'
      AND type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
ORDER BY l.date DESC;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE TRIM(bond_type) = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(t.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM (
    SELECT a.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    UNION
    SELECT a.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
)
WHERE element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'ca'
);
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(b.bond_type) = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_bonds,
       m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T3.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(a.element)) = 's'
  AND TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
  AND b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
  FROM cust_totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
least AS (
  SELECT ct.Segment, ct.CustomerID, ct.total_consumption
  FROM cust_totals ct
  JOIN seg_min sm ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment AND sm.min_total = ct.total_consumption
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM least
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS difference_a,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS difference_b,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS difference_c
FROM seg_avg

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.Segment,
           SUM(p.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_seg m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment
     AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),

    SELECT elem1, elem2
    FROM combo_counts
    ORDER BY num_bonds DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
  FROM cust_totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
  FROM cust_totals ct
  JOIN seg_min sm ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment AND ct.total = sm.min_total
  GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
),
czk AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, c.Segment, t.total
    FROM totals t
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, z.total
    FROM czk z
    JOIN mins m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.total = m.min_total
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS DIFF_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS DIFF_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS DIFF_KAM_SME

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
)
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM pair_counts) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           c.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT a.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(a.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM annual a
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON a.Segment = m.Segment AND a.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND colour.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(id) AS REAL) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT superhero.height_cm FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c_eye.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
WHERE c_skin.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
         THEN 'In-patient' 
         ELSE 'Outpatient' 
       END AS More_Common,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / 
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Deviation_Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT T2.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + ( AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) ) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  )

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(T2.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS 'Albumin within normal range'
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
    )
) T
JOIN Patient P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'True'
    ELSE 'False'
END AS answer
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
) t;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."U-PRO" > 0
  AND L."U-PRO" < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.`First Date` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND T1."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(atom.element = 'c') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(label = '+') / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected AS con
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON con.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON con.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id 
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' 
  AND T2.element IN ('cl', 'c') 
  AND T3.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.molecule_id, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id 
FROM bond AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id 
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       (SELECT m.label FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS A1 ON T1.atom_id = A1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS A2 ON T1.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
WHERE A1.element = 'cl' AND A2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT lo.loan_id, lo.amount, lo.date
  FROM loan lo
  JOIN disp d ON lo.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
) l;
